dialogue.content: （本日はよろしくお願い致します。お時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for meeting with me today. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: （こんにちは。こちらこそ本日はよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. Likewise, I'm looking forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 23歳、女、会社にいくのがつらいです
dialogue.English: I'm 23 years old, female, and it's hard for me to go to work.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。会社に行くのがおつらいのですね。もう少しどのようにおつらいのか教えてもらえますか？話せるところからで大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. It sounds like going to work is difficult for you. Could you tell me a bit more about what makes it so difficult? You can start with whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: いま入社２年目なのですが、会社の人間関係がしんどくて
dialogue.English: I'm in my second year at the company now, and the relationships at work are really tough.

dialogue.content: １週間、うつ状態で休職しました。
dialogue.English: I took a one-week leave of absence due to a depressive state.

dialogue.content: １週間休む前と休んだあとの周りの自分の見る目の違いが苦しいです
dialogue.English: It's distressing how differently people look at me after I took that week off compared to before.

dialogue.content: 人間関係でお悩みなのなですね。休職もされたと。。それはおつらい状況ですね。おやすみされたのはいつ頃ですか？
dialogue.English: So you're struggling with workplace relationships. And you also took a leave of absence... That must be a very difficult situation. When did you take that leave?

dialogue.content: 半年前です
dialogue.English: It was six months ago.

dialogue.content: 半年前ですか。そこからはお休みせず、周りの目も気になる中、頑張っていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: Six months ago? So you haven't taken any time off since then, and you've been doing your best even while feeling self-conscious about how others see you.

dialogue.content: はい、休んだあと課長にうつ状態の診断書を見せたら、部内で別のグループに異動になりました
dialogue.English: Yes. After my leave, I showed my manager the medical certificate for my depressive state, and I was transferred to another group within the department.

dialogue.content: 今は、お客さんというか、「マニュアル読んでて」と言われてただマニュアルを机で読むだけです
dialogue.English: Now, it's like I'm a guest, or rather, I'm just told, "Read the manual," and all I do is sit at my desk and read it.

dialogue.content: みんな、腫れ物にさわるような感じの接し方です。
dialogue.English: Everyone treats me like they're walking on eggshells around me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。職場の方の接し方やお仕事の内容も変わってしまったのですね。それが今おつらいのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So the way your colleagues treat you and the nature of your work have changed. And that's what's troubling you now.

dialogue.content: はい。休む前は、「優秀な新人」として期待されてました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Before I took time off, I was seen as a "promising newcomer" and had high expectations placed on me.

dialogue.content: 今は、評価の号級もかなり下げられてしまいました。
dialogue.English: Now, my performance rating has been lowered significantly.

dialogue.content: 悔しいです
dialogue.English: It's frustrating.

dialogue.content: 期待されていたのですね。それが一変するときついですね。。悔しいお気持ち、よくわかります。お休みされるきっかけも人間関係でのお悩みだったのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: You had high expectations placed on you. It must be tough for that to change so suddenly... I can really understand your feelings of frustration. Was the reason you took leave also related to issues with relationships at work?

dialogue.content: はい、アラフォーの女性の先輩が、かなりクセのある方なのですが、その人のストレスが大きかったです
dialogue.English: Yes, there's a senior female colleague in her forties with a difficult personality, and she was a major source of stress for me.

dialogue.content: ストレスでうつ状態になってしまんですね。先輩からのストレスは心身的ダメージも大きかったとお察しします。。
dialogue.English: So the stress led to a depressive state. I can imagine that the stress from your senior colleague took a large mental and physical toll on you...

dialogue.content: 今はうつの方の症状はどうですか？
dialogue.English: How are your depressive symptoms now?

dialogue.content: 今は、薬を飲んで、仕事自体の負担も少ないですし、症状は落ち着いています。
dialogue.English: Right now, I'm taking medication and my workload is light, so my symptoms have stabilized.

dialogue.content: もっと仕事できるのに、と思っているけれどなかなか責任のある仕事を任せてもらえません。
dialogue.English: I feel like I can handle more work, but they won't entrust me with any responsible tasks.

dialogue.content: 症状は落ち着いているようでよかったです。。ただ、また別の壁があるということですよね。ストレスの要因となっていた先輩とも離れた職場になっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear your symptoms have stabilized... But it sounds like you're facing a different kind of challenge now. Are you in a different work area from the senior colleague who was the source of your stress?

dialogue.content: 隣の島にその先輩はいるので、私の悪口を言っているのが聞こえてきます。
dialogue.English: That senior colleague is in the next group of desks, so I can hear her bad-mouthing me.

dialogue.content: その先輩と働いていた時の課長は、私が訴えたことをその先輩には直接伝えなかったので、その先輩は自分のせいだとは全く思っていないです
dialogue.English: The manager from when I worked with her never directly told her what I had complained about, so she has no idea that she's the reason for it.

dialogue.content: 課長もその先輩に仕事してもらわなきゃいけないから、モチベーションをさげないように言い方を考えたんでしょうけど・・・
dialogue.English: I guess the manager had to be careful with his words to avoid lowering her motivation, since he needs her to do her work, but...

dialogue.content: 私は、うつになる前にもその先輩のストレスについてたびたび課長に相談していました。
dialogue.English: Even before I became depressed, I had frequently consulted the manager about the stress from that senior colleague.

dialogue.content: でも何も対応してくれませんでした
dialogue.English: But he never did anything about it.

dialogue.content: そうですか、それは嫌な気持ちになりますね。課長には相談されていて、何も対応がなかったのですね。今後も改善はしないと思われているのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see, that must have been upsetting. You consulted with your manager, but he took no action. So you feel that the situation is unlikely to improve in the future...

dialogue.content: 私が、診断書をだしてはじめて課長は上席（統括マネージャー）に報告し、「はじめて今回ききました」と嘘を言ったようです。
dialogue.English: It was only after I submitted my doctor's note that my manager reported it to his superior (the general manager), and apparently, he lied and said, "This is the first I'm hearing of it."

dialogue.content: 課長は自分の保身が第一なのだな、と思いました
dialogue.English: I realized that the manager's top priority is protecting himself.

dialogue.content: それはひどいですね・・・
dialogue.English: That's terrible...

dialogue.content: 統括マネージャーが呼び出してくれて、２人で面談する機会があり、その時に知りました
dialogue.English: The general manager called me in for a one-on-one meeting, and that's when I found out.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。みかさんはその時どう思われましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did you feel at that time, Mika?

dialogue.content: 課長に幻滅しましたし、不信感を持ちました
dialogue.English: I was disillusioned with my manager and lost all trust in him.

dialogue.content: 今回のことで、自分だけがダメージを受けて、周りは何のお咎めもなし、というのがやりきれないです。なんで私はこんな目に遭うのだろう・・・と
dialogue.English: It's unbearable that I'm the only one who's been hurt by this, while everyone else gets away with it. I can't help but wonder, "Why do I have to go through this?"

dialogue.content: 不信感を持っても仕方ない状況だと思います。課長を信頼してお話ししてたんですもんね。
dialogue.English: I think it's completely understandable that you've lost trust in him. You confided in him, trusting him.

dialogue.content: 周りが変わらないのもやりきれないと。。。そう思うのは当然ですね。
dialogue.English: And feeling that it's unbearable that nothing around you is changing... It's only natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 悔しいし悲しいし、、別の部署の同期とかもこのこと（私が休職して異動になったこと）知ってるのかな、と思うと、同期ともあまり深くかかわりたくないです
dialogue.English: It's frustrating and sad... and when I wonder if my peers in other departments know about this (that I took a leave and was transferred), I don't want to get too involved with them either.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。悔しい、悲しいお気持ち、よくわかります。ここまで色々教えてくださって、ご自身のうつ状態、周りの目、課長への不信感、お仕事の内容、変わらない先輩社員など、いろいろな心配事があると思うのですが、
dialogue.English: I understand... I can really see how you feel frustrated and sad. Thank you for sharing all of this with me. It seems you have many concerns, such as your depression, how others see you, your mistrust of your manager, your work tasks, and the senior colleague who hasn't changed.

dialogue.content: 今、一番何がおつらいですか？
dialogue.English: Right now, what is the most difficult thing for you?

dialogue.content: 仕事をまかせてもらえないこと、評価がガクっと下がったことです。みじめです
dialogue.English: Not being entrusted with work and the sharp drop in my evaluation. I feel miserable.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。もともと優秀なみかさんだからこそ、みじめに感じてしまうのですね。ただ、心の体調不良は誰にでも起こることですし、みかさんならここからまた活躍できると思うので、少しでも今の状況がよくなるよう一緒に考えられればと思います。
dialogue.English: I see... It's precisely because you're such a capable person, Mika, that you feel so miserable. However, mental health challenges can happen to anyone, and I believe you can thrive again. I'd like us to think together about how we can improve your current situation, even just a little.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、統括マネージャーという方と面談されたとのことでしたが、その方はみかさんのお話しをしっかり聞いてくださったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you had a meeting with the general manager. Did he listen carefully to what you had to say?

dialogue.content: 「前々から課長に〇〇さんのことを相談していました」とは伝えました
dialogue.English: I told him, "I had been consulting my manager about Ms. XX for a long time."

dialogue.content: 「僕が聞いた話とは違うなあ」と言っていました。私の言ったことは信じてくれたようです
dialogue.English: He said, "That's different from what I heard." It seems like he believed what I said.

dialogue.content: でも、だからといって課長は降格とか評価下がるとかもなく、痛くもかゆくもありません
dialogue.English: But that doesn't mean the manager was demoted or had his rating lowered. He hasn't faced any consequences.

dialogue.content: 理解はしてもらえ、課長との意見の違いにも疑問は持ってもらえたのですね。
dialogue.English: So he understood your side of the story and questioned the discrepancy with what your manager said.

dialogue.content: ただ、環境はなかなかすぐには変わらない。。
dialogue.English: But the environment doesn't change so easily...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先ほど仕事を任せてもらえないことが今一番つらいことと教えてくれましたが、みかさんご自身は、今の状況がどうなったらいいなと思いますか？
dialogue.English: You told me a moment ago that not being entrusted with work is the most painful thing for you right now. For you personally, Mika, how would you like your current situation to be?

dialogue.content: 責任のある仕事も任せてもらえるようになって、生き生きと働けるようになりたいです
dialogue.English: I want to be entrusted with responsible work again and be able to work with energy and enthusiasm.

dialogue.content: そして号級も上がりたいです
dialogue.English: And I want my rating to go up too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。うつ状態を経験しながらも今また前向きに働こうとされているみかさんならきっとできると思います！少しお仕事について教えてもらいたいのですが、今はマニュアル業務のようなこととおっしゃっていましたが、みかさんにとって責任あるお仕事とはどのようなことですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. For someone like you, Mika, who is trying to work proactively again even after experiencing depression, I'm sure you can do it! I'd like to ask a little about your work. You mentioned you're doing manual-based tasks now, but what kind of work do you consider to be "responsible work"?

dialogue.content: 専門的で、プロフェッショナルといえるようなスキルを必要とする仕事です
dialogue.English: It's specialized work that requires professional skills.

dialogue.content: プロフェッショナル、かっこいいですね！今の部署（もしくは課）ではそれは叶わないとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: 'Professional'—that sounds great! Do you think that's not attainable in your current department (or section)?

dialogue.content: うーん、今のマニュアルの仕事は、今の先輩が定形フォーマットやルールを作り上げて、その先輩はすごく評価されています
dialogue.English: Hmm, for the current manual-based work, my current senior colleague created the standard formats and rules, and she's highly praised for it.

dialogue.content: でも、正直わたしは今の仕事にはあまり興味がなくて、、前の先輩と離れたくて異動させてもらったのに、ぜいたくは言えませんが
dialogue.English: But to be honest, I'm not very interested in the current work... I know I can't be too choosy, since I asked to be transferred to get away from my previous senior colleague.

dialogue.content: 会社にジョブチャレンジ制度というのがありますが、私の今の状況では受け容れられないと思います
dialogue.English: The company has something called a "Job Challenge Program," but I don't think I'd be accepted in my current situation.

dialogue.content: また病気になるんじゃないか、って思われるので
dialogue.English: Because they'd probably think I might get sick again.

dialogue.content: なるほど、必ずしもそのお仕事が部署や課に起因することではないのですね。具体的にどんな仕事がしたいか（行きたい部署や課）思いで学ものがありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that type of work isn't necessarily tied to a specific department or section. Do you have anything specific in mind, like the kind of work you'd like to do, or a department you'd like to join?

dialogue.content: （思い描くものはありますか？でした。失礼しました。）
dialogue.English: (I meant to ask, "Do you have something you envision?" My apologies.)

dialogue.content: マニュアルの仕事の他に、少し米国会計といって今の課長がしている業務があり、すこしずつ教えてもらっています。そっちの方が楽しいです
dialogue.English: Besides the manual-based work, there's some work related to U.S. accounting that my current manager does, and he's been teaching it to me little by little. I enjoy that more.

dialogue.content: 今のお仕事の中でも少しずつやりがいを見出せているのですね。素晴らしいですね。誰でもできることではないと思います。与えられたことをやる方が楽だという考えもありますし・・・
dialogue.English: So you're gradually finding a sense of purpose even in your current job. That's wonderful. I don't think that's something everyone can do. Some people think it's easier just to do what you're told...

dialogue.content: 課長から業務時間中に米国会計のことを教えてもらっているのをみて、「何かがおかしい、甘やかしすぎだ」と批判してくる人もいます。
dialogue.English: Some people see the manager teaching me about U.S. accounting during work hours and criticize it, saying things like, "Something's not right, she's being coddled."

dialogue.content: そんな心無い声もあるんですね、、、今の職場で体調を少しずつ戻しながら、今すでに取り組んでいるようにできることからチャレンジし、ゆくゆくはジョブチャレンジ制度に応募していくという流れが良いのかなとお見受けしましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: So there are such heartless comments as well... It seems to me that a good course of action might be to gradually get your health back on track at your current workplace, continue to take on challenges you can handle as you are already doing, and eventually apply for the Job Challenge Program. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、ジョブチャレンジ制度はわかりませんが、今はとりあえず目の前にあることを一生けん命取り組む、学べることを学ぶ、しかないのかなと思いました
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm not sure about the Job Challenge Program, but for now, I feel that all I can do is devote myself to what's in front of me and learn what I can.

dialogue.content: 周りの目を気にしないで安定した自分をつくって自分のペースで進んでいけるようになりたいです
dialogue.English: I want to build a stable sense of self so I can move forward at my own pace without worrying about what others think.

dialogue.content: なのに周りに翻弄されてしまう自分がいます
dialogue.English: And yet, I find myself being swayed by those around me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。どうしても周りが気になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You can't help but be concerned about what others think.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: それはよくわかります。ただ、外部環境はなかなか変えられないい、かえるためには大きなパワーが必要になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand that very well. But the external environment is difficult to change, and it takes a lot of energy to do so, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、「周りの目を気にしないで安定した自分をつくる」にはどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. What can I do to "build a stable sense of self without worrying about what others think"?

dialogue.content: 私はみかさんには大きな外部環境を変えることはできなくても、ご自身やご自身の身近な環境を変えていくパワーはお持ちだと、今日お話しして感じました。
dialogue.English: From our conversation today, I feel that while you may not be able to change the larger external environment, Mika, you do have the power to change yourself and your immediate surroundings.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか・・・自信がありません
dialogue.English: Do you think so...? I'm not confident.

dialogue.content: ご自身の周りにあるチャンスをしっかり掴んで、常に前を向いて進んでいく力があると思います。
dialogue.English: I believe you have the ability to seize the opportunities around you and keep moving forward.

dialogue.content: 現に、環境が何も変わらなくても、統括マネージャーの方に理解を求めたり、今の課長さんから、次のステップに進む業務を教えてもらうなど、
dialogue.English: In fact, even when the environment didn't change, you sought understanding from the general manager and are learning tasks from your current manager that will lead to the next step,

dialogue.content: 少しづつご自身で環境を変えられていますよね。
dialogue.English: —little by little, you are changing your environment yourself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それは、とてもすごいことだと思いますし、これからの長い社会人生でもみかさんの強みになると思います。
dialogue.English: I think that's really impressive, and it will be a strength for you throughout your long career.

dialogue.content: うつ状態ともこれから付き合いながらのお仕事人生になるかと思いますが、それもうまくコントロールしながらご自身のペースで、前に進んで欲しいなと思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine you'll be navigating your work life while also managing your depression at times, but I hope you'll move forward at your own pace while managing it well.

dialogue.content: うつ状態はこれからも付き合わなければいけないのでしょうか・・・
dialogue.English: Will I have to live with this depressive state from now on...?

dialogue.content: 治るものだと思っていたので・・・
dialogue.English: I thought it was something that could be cured...

dialogue.content: 今、克服されたと感じられていれば問題ないと思いますが、また、ストレスを感じたら発症する可能性もあるかと思います。あくまで一般論ですので、必ずしもみかさんに当てはまるとは限りません。ただ、ご自身の心身の健康は保って頂きたいな、と思っています。
dialogue.English: If you feel you've overcome it now, then that's fine, but I think there is a possibility it could reoccur if you experience stress again. This is just a general statement, so it doesn't necessarily apply to you, Mika. However, I do hope that you will maintain your own mental and physical health.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I see, thank you.

dialogue.content: ご自身を軸に前に進んでいかれたら、少しは周りの目も気にならなくなるかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you keep yourself as your anchor and move forward, I think you'll become less concerned about what others think. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね、周りの声や目が気になったときは、自分が今何を習得したいのか、どうなりたいのかを意識するようにしたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, when I'm bothered by others' comments or looks, I'll try to refocus on what I want to learn now and what I want to become.

dialogue.content: きっとみかさんならうまくいくと思います！応援しています！
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'll do great, Mika! I'm rooting for you!

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: また何かあれば相談に来てくださいね。では、本日は終了とさせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back if you need to talk again. We'll end the session here for today.

dialogue.content: （本日はお疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。忌憚ないFBをお願い致します！終了ボタン押させて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. I would appreciate your candid feedback! I will now press the end button.)
